kept.heading: MORE THAN HALF OF MARKETERS HAVE NO CLEAR READ ON UGC CREATOR ROI (3 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: 57% of marketers have no clear understanding of whether UGC creator spending delivers positive returns, with 38% not measuring creator costs against acquisition economics. Nearly half of teams allocate less than 5% of ad spend to UGC. Instagram and TikTok are the top creator sourcing channels at 74%. Authenticity is the top creator selection criterion, with 96% prioritizing creators who are authentic on camera.

kept.heading: IS SOMETHING UP WITH YOUTUBE'S AD BUSINESS? (2 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: YouTube's ad revenue growth is slowing despite its growing share of TV viewing, raising questions about whether it can convert its CTV audience into more advertising dollars. Its ad revenue grew 9% to $11.2 billion in Q3, even as it captured 15.8% of total TV viewing. Several factors may explain the gap: YouTube missed out on political ad spending, some brands still view FAST platforms as more traditional TV environments, and advertisers are diversifying their CTV budgets instead of concentrating spend on YouTube. Growing competition from Meta and YouTube's expanding ad-free subscription options may also limit its advertising growth.

kept.heading: WIN REPORT: HOW AN INFOGRAPHIC INCREASED CONVERSIONS BY 15% (2 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: DiamondBack Covers increased product page conversions by 15% by replacing an early product gallery image with an infographic that paired key product features with their customer benefits. Research found that 43% of buyers cited security as their main purchase reason, yet fewer than 13% of visitors scrolled far enough to see important selling messages about protection and durability. The infographic highlighted four selling points: durable aluminum construction, gas spring-assisted openings, weatherproof seals, and secure locking mechanisms. Pairing each feature with a specific benefit gave shoppers both a reason to care and proof to support the claim.

kept.heading: WHY AI INFLUENCERS WORK BETTER WITH A HUMAN FRIEND (3 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: Seeing an AI influencer relate to a real person makes it seem more human, which raises trust and lifts engagement. Posts showing them sharing a genuine moment with a real person, like eating together or posing arm in arm, drew about 21% more engagement in a sample of 10,000 IG posts. A bystander in the frame or a second AI character has no effect, and the lift is biggest for the most artificial-looking avatars.

kept.heading: REDDIT 2027 MOMENTS ANNUAL GUIDE (18 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: This Reddit guide maps cultural events, sports, and life milestones that brands can use to plan campaigns around community conversations. 3 in 4 Reddit users are open to considering a new brand after seeing a community recommendation, even if it costs more. Half of shoppers use Reddit to verify AI recommendations, while 56% of holiday shoppers look for deals and promotions before buying.

kept.heading: FIND SITE ERRORS WITH AI BEFORE ADS RUN (2 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: Use AI to audit campaign landing pages before ads go live and catch problems that could prevent shoppers from converting. Tools like ChatGPT and Claude can review screenshots, page content, and crawl reports to identify broken links, conflicting offers, inaccurate product availability, missing information, and mobile layout issues. Pair AI analysis with technical tools like Google Lighthouse and Screaming Frog, then manually test the shopping journey on desktop and mobile, including checkout and ad conversion tracking. Prioritize issues by their potential impact on customers, and repeat the audit before every campaign.

kept.heading: REDDIT JUST STOPPED GIVING ITSELF AWAY (5 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: Reddit is testing a logged-in-only experience to reduce unmonetized traffic and protect its content from AI scraping. The move follows a 53% revenue increase but slower user growth in the US. Meanwhile, Discord is making public communities searchable on Google to attract new members. Both platforms are adapting to AI-driven search by balancing public content discovery with member access.

kept.heading: WE PUSHED ACQUISITION TOO HARD. COMPLAINTS FOLLOWED (5 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: After increasing co-registration subscribers for its Trivia Nut newsletter, a publisher saw Gmail's spam complaint rate exceed 0.30% for 4 days and peak at 0.49%. It cut incoming subscriber volume by 50%, bringing the next reported rate down to 0.06%. The publisher recommends monitoring Gmail's spam rate separately through Postmaster Tools and checking acquisition sources when complaints rise.

kept.heading: NARRATIVE INTELLIGENCE VS. SOCIAL LISTENING: WHAT'S THE DIFFERENCE? (9 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: Social listening measures what people discuss online through metrics like mentions, reach, and sentiment. Narrative Intelligence adds context by revealing how topics are interpreted through different narratives. It identifies who is shaping conversations and which communities are driving or encountering them. The two approaches work together to help teams understand why conversations matter. For example, overall sentiment may appear neutral while a specific narrative contains concentrated negative sentiment.

kept.heading: HOW COMPANIES ARE PIVOTING THEIR BRANDS TO BE MASCOT-LED (10 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: Character-led campaigns are more likely to report big market share gains, 41% versus 30%, yet brands largely dropped mascots until AI companies revived them.

kept.heading: ONLY 54% OF CONSUMERS TRUST THAT BLACK FRIDAY DISCOUNTS ARE LOWER THAN NORMAL (2 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: Retailer reputation and money-back guarantees build the most trust in a deal, while influencer recommendations rank last.

WHY REDDIT'S INFLUENCE ISN'T GOING DOWN (8 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: Reddit influences product research and purchase decisions through peer recommendations and discussions that shape Google results and AI-generated answers, even without direct citations. Its organic traffic grew from 46M monthly visits in November 21 to 495M in October 26. An analysis of 58 clients found a median of 9% of LLM responses cited Reddit. Threads also shape buyer expectations through product comparisons and real-world feedback, which can influence third-party reviews and AI recommendations.

kept.heading: TIKTOK QUIETLY LAUNCHES A STAND-ALONE TIKTOK SHOP APP (2 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: TikTok launched a standalone TikTok Shop app in Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, and the Philippines. The app features livestream and video shopping, exclusive deals, and in-app checkout. The move gives TikTok Shop a dedicated shopping destination beyond its main social app and puts it in more direct competition with Amazon and Temu.

kept.heading: SHOULD YOU INCORPORATE AI IN YOUR POSITIONING? (10 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: Companies have three ways to position AI in their product strategy. They can pivot into a new AI category when it offers stronger growth potential and solves a clear customer need; they can use AI to stand out in an established category, as Gamma does against PowerPoint and Google Slides; or they can keep their existing positioning and treat AI as a supporting feature. The choice should reflect what customers value rather than AI hype.

kept.heading: YOUTUBE DESCRIPTION UPDATES LINKED TO 359% RISE IN AI RETRIEVALS (1 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: Updating YouTube descriptions may improve video visibility in AI search. A Peec AI experiment found that videos with updated descriptions saw a 359% increase in daily AI retrievals, compared with 17% for unchanged videos. Retrievals also rose 293% in Google AI Overviews and 129% in AI Mode. The experiment updated descriptions on 15 of roughly 60 videos. Adding structured details and manual timestamps could help AI systems surface existing videos.

kept.heading: HOW TO GROW ORGANIC YOUTUBE VIEWS (OUR 40M+ PLAYBOOK) (WEBINAR)
kept.blurb: People are already searching for what your product answers. A good video answers it and keeps working for itself. In this webinar, Tim Zaal will walk through how to research what people already search around your product, then turn those searches into videos that get found. The free webinar will take place on November 10 at 7 AM.

kept.heading: HOW TO BUILD A UTM LINK (3 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: This free UTM Link Builder creates campaign URLs with tracking parameters for traffic source, channel, and campaign name. It supports optional keyword and content tags to distinguish links. The tool flags formatting issues such as mixed capitalization or spaces. It also detects existing tracking parameters that will be overwritten and automatically adds HTTPS when missing.

kept.heading: A PRACTITIONER'S FIELD GUIDE TO MARKETING ENGINEERING (9 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: Marketing engineering uses technical skills to turn repetitive marketing tasks into automated systems. Instead of manually running campaigns, marketers build systems that continuously monitor market activity and identify opportunities. These systems can also produce and distribute content. The goal is to scale marketing efforts and run more experiments without adding headcount. AI coding tools make this possible without requiring a computer science degree.

kept.heading: AI KNOWS WHAT YOUR BRAND DOES, BUT NOT WHO IT'S FOR (15 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: AI answers named a brand's ideal customer correctly only 60% of the time. Proof points like customer counts rarely appeared, and half of detailed brand descriptions included none. Where information was missing, engines often guessed, and 34% of answers contained an invented fact, most often a price. Positioning held up best when brands stated it simply and repeated it everywhere.

kept.heading: WHAT IS AN AI AGENT FOR SEO? HOW IT DIFFERS FROM SEO TOOLS (5 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: Traditional SEO tools provide data and recommendations but leave execution to users. AI SEO agents go further by working across connected tools to complete tasks such as keyword research and performance reporting. They can run on schedules or respond to requests with limited human input. More advanced agents can manage entire workflows, but publishing and technical changes should still require human approval.

kept.heading: ALEXA FOR SHOPPING IS NOW JUST A TEXT AWAY (5 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: Shoppers can text requests or photos to Amazon's agent, which searches and completes the purchase on their behalf.

kept.heading: BEHIND THE SCENES OF IKEA'S RAPID-RESPONSE SOCIAL TEAM (8 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: IKEA tests trends quickly with minimal budgets and approval.
